# CampingKiezer

> Onafhankelijke Nederlandse vergelijker voor campings, camperplaatsen, bungalowparken, glampinglocaties en vakantieparken.

Canonical site: https://camping-kiezer.nl/
Language: nl-NL
Navigation updated: 2026-09-05 (not a new verification date for individual profiles)
Visible location profiles: 4112

## Interpretation rules
- Missing data is unknown, not automatically absent.
- Profile completeness is not a quality score or review.
- Prices, ratings and availability are not invented.
- Current prices, availability and conditions must be verified with the provider.
- Category counts can overlap because one location may offer multiple stay types.
- Claim status concerns verification on CampingKiezer, not ownership of the physical location.

## Crawling
The canonical sitemap index is https://camping-kiezer.nl/sitemap.xml.
Faceted search parameters are intentionally excluded from indexing.

This file is a navigation aid. It does not claim or imply ranking benefits.
